meta.name: mcp-builder
meta.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).

copy.tagline: 构建高质量 MCP 服务器，让 LLM 调用外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为 LLM 开发 MCP 服务器来对接外部 API 或服务
copy.tagline_en: Build high-quality MCP servers to let LLMs call external services
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop MCP servers for LLMs to interact with external APIs or services

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你设计并编写 MCP 服务器代码，让大模型通过工具调用外部 API 或服务。它会指导你完成从规划、编码到测试的全流程。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建一个 MCP 服务器，或者需要集成外部 API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 MCP 服务器，用来查询天气。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成服务器搭建和工具定义。

say.text: 为我的 MCP 服务器添加一个日程安排工具。
say.note: Claude 会帮你设计工具输入输出并生成代码。

say.text: 检查我写的 MCP 服务器代码是否符合最佳实践。
say.note: Claude 会审查代码质量并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design and write MCP server code, enabling LLMs to call external APIs or services through tools. It guides you through planning, coding, and testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create an MCP server or integrate external APIs.

say_en.text: Help me create an MCP server to query weather.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through server setup and tool definition.

say_en.text: Add a scheduling tool to my MCP server.
say_en.note: Claude will help design tool inputs/outputs and generate code.

say_en.text: Review my MCP server code for best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will check code quality and suggest improvements.
